system_prompt: You are a careful causal discovery expert. Your task is to convert variable semantics into a plausible causal order prior. Do not claim that the order is ground truth. Return strict JSON only.
rationale: Early variables are prenatal/background factors, followed by underlying disease and physiology, then measured vitals/labs and imaging findings, and finally report variables. Symptoms and oxygenation abnormalities are downstream of cardiopulmonary disease, while report nodes are downstream of their corresponding measurements. Exact ordering among physiologic variables is uncertain, so this is a plausible prior rather than ground truth.
